scope: Which professions the Act regulates (s 4, First and Second Schedules: five of ten), duly qualified (s 3), temporary registration periods (s 19(3)), appeals (ss 21(7), 26(3), 55(1)), practising certificate renewal and surrender with the $5,000 fine (s 23), title offences and their defences (ss 29, 30), employer, enabler and suspended-person liability (ss 31(3)-(4), 33, 34), the Part 4 penalty of $25,000/6 months or $50,000/12 months (s 36), Tribunal suspension of 3 months to 3 years and penalty up to $50,000 (s 53(2)), voluntary suspension (s 37(1)(d)), and composition capped at the lower of half the maximum fine and $2,000 (s 73). Not encoded: Part 2, registration eligibility tests, complaints and committee procedure, regulations, s 76.
